req.title: Return DELETE request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to DELETE /delete with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that DELETE /delete returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a plain DELETE request and assert all required keys exist with exact types/values; (2) verify query-string args are reflected exactly; (3) verify JSON body payload is echoed; (4) verify form data is echoed; (5) verify that a wrong HTTP method (GET) to /delete returns 405, not 200; (6) verify boundary condition of empty vs non-empty args dict. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_plain_returns_200_with_all_required_keys
actions: Send DELETE /delete with no body or query params
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_plain_returns_200_with_all_required_keys():
    r = client.delete('/delete')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == required_keys
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert isinstance(body['args'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['form'], dict)
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert body['json'] is None

test_delete_plain_returns_200_with_all_required_keys()

tests.name: test_delete_with_query_args_reflected_exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_with_query_args_reflected_exactly():
    r = client.delete('/delete?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'foo=bar' in body['url'] or 'baz=qux' in body['url']

test_delete_with_query_args_reflected_exactly()

tests.name: test_delete_with_json_body_reflected
actions: Send DELETE /delete with Content-Type application/json and JSON body {"key": "value"}
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_with_json_body_reflected():
    payload = json.dumps({'key': 'value'})
    r = client.delete(
        '/delete',
        data=payload,
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['json'] == {'key': 'value'}
    assert body['data'] == payload
    assert body['form'] == {}

test_delete_with_json_body_reflected()

tests.name: test_delete_headers_reflected_in_response
actions: Send DELETE /delete with custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel
expected: headers dict in response contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_headers_reflected_in_response():
    r = client.delete('/delete', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert 'x-test-header' in headers_lower
    assert headers_lower['x-test-header'] == 'sentinel'

test_delete_headers_reflected_in_response()

tests.name: test_delete_no_extra_keys_in_response
actions: Send DELETE /delete and inspect all top-level keys
expected: Response JSON has exactly 8 keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin — no more, no less
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_no_extra_keys_in_response():
    r = client.delete('/delete')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    actual_keys = set(body.keys())
    assert actual_keys == expected_keys
    assert len(actual_keys) == 8
    assert 'method' not in actual_keys
